sections.template: {{company||We}} use cookies and similar tracking technologies on this website. Cookies are small text files placed on your device to help the site function, remember your preferences, analyse traffic and improve your experience.

sections.title: Types of cookies we use
items: Strictly necessary cookies: required for the website to operate and to maintain security. These cookies do not collect personal information and are set on the basis of our legitimate interests.
Preference cookies: remember your settings and choices to improve your experience.
Analytics cookies: help us understand how visitors interact with the website so that we can improve it. Where analytics data may identify you, we rely on an appropriate lawful basis under UK GDPR.

Marketing or third-party cookies: set by approved service providers (for example, advertising or social media partners) and governed by their own privacy notices. These are used only with your consent where required.

sections.template: You can manage or disable cookies through our cookie banner or your browser settings. Please note that restricting strictly necessary cookies may affect the functionality of the website. By continuing to use this website, you consent to the use of non-essential cookies in accordance with this notice.

sections.template: This privacy policy explains how {{company||we}} collects, uses, protects and shares personal information. By using our website or providing your personal information to us, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this policy.

sections.template: {{company||We}} are the data controller for the personal information collected through this website and our related services. Our contact details are:

sections.template: We have appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) who is responsible for overseeing questions in relation to this privacy policy. If you have any questions, please contact our DPO at {{officer_email||{{email}}}}.

sections.title: What personal information we collect
sections.template: Personal information means any information about an individual from which that person can be identified. We may collect:

items: Directly from you: name, contact details, identity or company registration number, billing and payment information, and any other information you provide when you register, request a quote, place an order, subscribe to newsletters or contact us.

Automatically: IP address, browser type and version, device information, operating system, pages viewed, time spent on the site, referring URLs and other analytics data collected via cookies and similar technologies.

sections.title: How we use your personal information
sections.template: We use personal information only where we have a lawful basis, including to:

items: provide our products and services;
process orders, payments and deliveries;
communicate with you, including service-related messages;
send direct marketing where permitted and with an opportunity to opt out;
improve our website, services and customer experience;
comply with legal and regulatory obligations; and
protect our rights, property and legitimate interests.

sections.title: Legal basis for processing
sections.template: Under UK GDPR, we process personal information on the following legal bases:

items: Consent: where you have given clear consent, for example to receive marketing communications.
Contract: where processing is necessary for a contract with you or to take steps at your request before entering into a contract.
Legal obligation: where we are required to process information by law.
Legitimate interests: where processing is necessary for our legitimate business interests, provided your rights and interests do not override those interests.
Vital interests or public task: where applicable.

sections.title: Direct marketing and opt-out
sections.template: We may send you promotional communications by email, SMS or other channels, but only where permitted by UK GDPR and PECR. You may opt out of direct marketing at any time by contacting us at {{officer_email||{{email}}}} or using the unsubscribe link in any marketing message.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.template: We use cookies and similar technologies to collect device and usage data. For more information, please see our cookie notice.

sections.title: Sharing with third parties
sections.template: We do not sell personal information. We may share personal information with trusted third parties who assist us in operating our business, such as payment processors, delivery partners, IT service providers, marketing service providers, legal advisers and auditors. These third parties are required to maintain appropriate confidentiality and security safeguards and to process data only on our documented instructions.

sections.title: International transfers
sections.template: Personal information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside the UK. Where this occurs, we will ensure that appropriate safeguards are in place, such as adequacy regulations, standard contractual clauses, or other lawful transfer mechanisms under UK GDPR.

sections.title: Your data protection rights
sections.template: Under UK GDPR, you have the right to:

items: request access to your personal information;
request rectification of inaccurate or incomplete personal information;
request erasure of your personal information in certain circumstances;
request restriction of processing;
object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing;
request data portability;
withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent; and
lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).

sections.template: To exercise your rights, please contact us at {{officer_email||{{email}}}}. We may require proof of identity before processing your request.

sections.title: Retention
sections.template: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, to comply with legal obligations, to resolve disputes and to enforce our agreements.

sections.title: Security
sections.template: We implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures to safeguard personal information against accidental loss, unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or destruction. No internet-based system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.title: Complaints to the ICO
sections.template: If you believe we have infringed your data protection rights, you may contact the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO). Contact details are available at ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint.

sections.title: Children's privacy
sections.template: Our services are not directed to children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children without appropriate parental consent.

sections.title: Changes to this privacy policy
sections.template: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The current version will be published on our website with the date of the latest revision. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
This publication scheme is provided in accordance with the Freedom of Information Act 2000, the Environmental Information Regulations 2004 and the UK General Data Protection Regulation.

sections.title: Grounds for refusal

sections.template: At {{company||we}} want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This returns and refunds policy sets out your rights and our procedures.

sections.title: Your statutory rights
sections.template: Under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, goods must be of satisfactory quality, fit for purpose and as described. If goods are faulty, not as described or unfit for purpose, you have the right to a refund, repair or replacement.

sections.title: Faulty or misdescribed goods

sections.title: Cooling-off for distance and off-premises contracts
sections.template: If you are a consumer purchasing goods or services online, by telephone or away from our business premises, you generally have 14 days from the day you receive the goods (or from the date of the contract for services) to cancel for any reason and receive a full refund, unless an exception applies.

sections.title: Return window
sections.template: Subject to the exclusions below, you may return goods within {{returnwindow}} days of delivery, provided the goods are unused, undamaged and in their original packaging with all tags and accessories.

sections.title: Condition of returned goods
sections.template: Returned goods must be in original condition. We reserve the right to refuse a refund or exchange if the goods show signs of use, damage or wear that is not due to a defect, or if original packaging, accessories or documentation are missing.

sections.title: Refund method
sections.template: Refunds will be processed using the original payment method unless otherwise agreed. Refund processing times may vary depending on your payment provider. We will refund standard delivery costs where you are entitled to reject the goods under the Consumer Rights Act 2015.

sections.title: Exclusions
sections.template: Unless required by law, the following items may not be returned or refunded:

items: perishable goods;
personalised or custom-made goods;
goods that are sealed for health or hygiene reasons once unsealed;
sealed audio recordings, video recordings or computer software that have been opened after delivery; and
digital content after you have started downloading or streaming it, if you have consented.
